body: QWEN CHAT GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Introduction Last December, we launched QVQ-72B-Preview as an exploratory model, but it had many issues. Today, we are officially releasing the first version of QVQ-Max, our visual reasoning model. This model can not only “understand” the content in images and videos but also analyze and reason with this information to provide solutions. From math problems to everyday questions, from programming code to artistic creation, QVQ-Max has demonstrated impressive capabilities.
summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布其首个视觉推理模型QVQ-Max。该模型不仅能够理解图像和视频内容，还能进行深入的分析与推理，在数学问题求解、日常问答、编程代码及艺术创作等多种任务中表现出强大的综合视觉推理能力。原始信息显示：QWEN CHAT GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD Introduction Last December, we launched QVQ-72B-Preview as an exploratory model, but it had many issues. Today, we are officially releasing the first version of QVQ-Max, our visual reasoning model. This model can not only “understand” the content in images and videos but also analyze and reason with this infor。该消息由Qwen · 通义千问发布，主题为“QVQ-Max: Think with Evidence”。其重要性主要体现在：QVQ-Max作为视觉推理模型的正式发布，展示了开源多模型在复杂图文理解与推理上的进展。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
